Ben, Marissa — quick notes after reviewing Jesse's attachments and the draft SLA.

1) Measurement: We can accept customer-side aggregator measurements provided the probe list and measurement methodology are mutually agreed and we mirror those probes with our internal telemetry. For the contract language, we should add an agreed measurement appendix to avoid ambiguity.

2) 100ms P95 from customer edge is aggressive for multi-tenant paths unless they accept route scoping to hotspots (tokenization/short prompts) — otherwise we'd need dedicated routing or reserved nodes for those endpoints to consistently hit 100ms. That increases cost materially.

3) Pilot plan: Rafael will run a 2-week staging pilot in us-west-2 with a reserved node pool + prefix caching enabled. Estimated operational lift: 3 engineering days from Nimbus.

4) Credits: propose a 3-tier model: Minor (<30m): no credit; Major (30-120m): tiered credits up to 50%; Severe (>120m): 100% credit for impacted route-hours, plus a one-off service credit. We should be explicit on partial-hour calculations.

I'll produce a tech appendix and a delta-cost calc for pricing.

— Rafael
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
